items.question: Trong câu "App servers are stateless; the database holds state, which is hard to copy, split and keep consistent.", từ "stateless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "App servers are stateless; the database holds state, which is hard to copy, split and keep consistent.", what does "stateless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stateless /ˈsteɪtləs/ (tính từ): không lưu trạng thái. Server "stateless" có thể thêm/bớt tùy ý vì mọi dữ liệu nằm ở database.
items.explanationEn: stateless /ˈsteɪtləs/ (adjective): keeping no stored state. Stateless servers can be added or removed freely because the data lives in the database.

items.question: Trong câu "App servers are stateless; the database holds state, which is hard to copy, split and keep consistent.", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "App servers are stateless; the database holds state, which is hard to copy, split and keep consistent.", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán, khớp nhau. "Keep data consistent" = giữ cho các bản dữ liệu khớp nhau, không mâu thuẫn.
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): in agreement, not contradictory. "Keep data consistent" means making sure copies of the data never contradict each other.

items.question: Trong câu "Name the pressure first — slow queries, connections, reads, writes or size.", từ "pressure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Name the pressure first — slow queries, connections, reads, writes or size.", what does "pressure" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: strain or load on a system
items.explanation: pressure /ˈpreʃə(r)/ (danh từ): sức ép, áp lực (tải). "Under pressure" = chịu sức ép; ở đây là loại tải đang làm database chậm.
items.explanationEn: pressure /ˈpreʃə(r)/ (noun): strain or load on a system. "Under pressure" means under strain; here it is the kind of load slowing the database.

items.question: Trong câu "Each rung buys capacity and adds permanent complexity:", từ "rung" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each rung buys capacity and adds permanent complexity:", what does "rung" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rung /rʌŋ/ (danh từ): bậc (của cái thang). "Rung" là bậc thang; ẩn dụ cho từng bước mở rộng database theo thứ tự.
items.explanationEn: rung /rʌŋ/ (noun): one step of a ladder. A rung is a step on a ladder; here it is one stage in scaling the database.

items.question: Trong câu "Each rung buys capacity and adds permanent complexity:", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each rung buys capacity and adds permanent complexity:", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): khả năng chịu tải. "Add capacity" = tăng khả năng xử lý; "in my capacity as…" lại nghĩa là "với vai trò…".
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): ability to handle load. "Add capacity" means handling more load; "in my capacity as…" instead means "in my role as…".

items.question: Trong câu "Each rung buys capacity and adds permanent complexity:", từ "permanent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each rung buys capacity and adds permanent complexity:", what does "permanent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: permanent /ˈpɜːmənənt/ (tính từ): lâu dài, vĩnh viễn. "Permanent cost" = chi phí phải gánh mãi, không gỡ bỏ được.
items.explanationEn: permanent /ˈpɜːmənənt/ (adjective): lasting for good. A "permanent cost" is one you keep paying and cannot remove later.

items.question: Trong câu "A well-tuned single PostgreSQL or MySQL instance handles thousands of simple transactions per second.", từ "well-tuned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A well-tuned single PostgreSQL or MySQL instance handles thousands of simple transactions per second.", what does "well-tuned" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: well-tuned /ˌwel ˈtjuːnd/ (tính từ): được tinh chỉnh tốt. "Tune a database" = tinh chỉnh cấu hình, index để chạy nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: well-tuned /ˌwel ˈtjuːnd/ (adjective): carefully optimized. "Tune a database" means adjusting settings and indexes so it runs faster.

items.question: Trong câu "is too coarse; ask which data model and access pattern the workload has.", từ "coarse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is too coarse; ask which data model and access pattern the workload has.", what does "coarse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: coarse /kɔːs/ (tính từ): thô, chưa đủ chi tiết. "Coarse-grained" = phân loại thô; trái nghĩa là "fine-grained" (chi tiết).
items.explanationEn: coarse /kɔːs/ (adjective): too broad, lacking detail. "Coarse-grained" means broadly split; the opposite is "fine-grained".

items.question: Trong câu "is too coarse; ask which data model and access pattern the workload has.", từ "workload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is too coarse; ask which data model and access pattern the workload has.", what does "workload" (noun) mean?
options: khối lượng công việc xử lý
items.explanation: workload /ˈwɜːkləʊd/ (danh từ): khối lượng công việc xử lý. Trong IT, "workload" là kiểu truy vấn/tải mà hệ thống phải phục vụ.
items.explanationEn: workload /ˈwɜːkləʊd/ (noun): the processing a system handles. In IT, a "workload" is the kind of queries and traffic a system must serve.

items.question: Trong câu "design is model the queries, then shape the data — denormalised and fast, but a new access pattern may need a migration.", từ "migration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "design is model the queries, then shape the data — denormalised and fast, but a new access pattern may need a migration.", what does "migration" (noun) mean?
options: sự di cư của loài chim
sự nhập cư vào quốc gia
items.explanation: migration /maɪˈɡreɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự chuyển đổi dữ liệu/schema. "Run a migration" = chạy script thay đổi cấu trúc hoặc chuyển dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: migration /maɪˈɡreɪʃn/ (noun): moving or reshaping stored data. "Run a migration" means executing a script that reshapes or moves data.

items.question: Trong câu "Without an index the engine scans every row: O(n).", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without an index the engine scans every row: O(n).", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to copy paper into an image
to go through items one by one
to check a PC for viruses
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt lần lượt từng mục. "Full table scan" = đọc toàn bộ bảng vì không có index phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to go through items one by one. A "full table scan" reads the whole table because no suitable index exists.

items.question: Trong câu "A B-tree (really a B+tree) keeps keys sorted in pages (8 KB in PostgreSQL, 16 KB in InnoDB).", từ "sort" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A B-tree (really a B+tree) keeps keys sorted in pages (8 KB in PostgreSQL, 16 KB in InnoDB).", what does "sort" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sort /sɔːt/ (động từ): sắp xếp theo thứ tự. "Keep keys sorted" = giữ khóa luôn theo thứ tự; "sort out" lại là giải quyết.
items.explanationEn: sort /sɔːt/ (verb): to put in order. "Keep keys sorted" means keeping them in order; "sort out" instead means to fix.

items.question: Trong câu "Each page holds hundreds of keys, so 3–4 levels cover hundreds of millions of rows and a lookup is O(log n):", từ "lookup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each page holds hundreds of keys, so 3–4 levels cover hundreds of millions of rows and a lookup is O(log n):", what does "lookup" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an act of finding a value
items.explanation: lookup /ˈlʊkʌp/ (danh từ): thao tác tra cứu. "Lookup" (danh từ) = một lần tra tìm; động từ tách rời là "look up".
items.explanationEn: lookup /ˈlʊkʌp/ (noun): an act of finding a value. A "lookup" (noun) is one search for a value; the verb is written "look up".

items.question: Trong câu "Composite indexes follow the leftmost-prefix rule — put equality columns first, then the range/sort column:", từ "composite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Composite indexes follow the leftmost-prefix rule — put equality columns first, then the range/sort column:", what does "composite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: composite /ˈkɒmpəzɪt/ (tính từ): gồm nhiều thành phần. "Composite index/key" = index/khóa ghép từ nhiều cột.
items.explanationEn: composite /ˈkɒmpəzɪt/ (adjective): made of several parts. A "composite index" or key is built from more than one column.

items.question: Trong câu "Composite indexes follow the leftmost-prefix rule — put equality columns first, then the range/sort column:", từ "prefix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Composite indexes follow the leftmost-prefix rule — put equality columns first, then the range/sort column:", what does "prefix" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the ending part of a word
the leading part of a sequence
items.explanation: prefix /ˈpriːfɪks/ (danh từ): phần đứng đầu (tiền tố). "Leftmost prefix" = các cột đầu tiên tính từ bên trái của index.
items.explanationEn: prefix /ˈpriːfɪks/ (noun): the leading part of a sequence. The "leftmost prefix" is the first columns of an index counted from the left.

items.question: Trong câu "Composite indexes follow the leftmost-prefix rule — put equality columns first, then the range/sort column:", từ "equality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Composite indexes follow the leftmost-prefix rule — put equality columns first, then the range/sort column:", what does "equality" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a test that values are equal
items.explanation: equality /iˈkwɒləti/ (danh từ): phép so sánh bằng. "Equality condition" = điều kiện dạng cột = giá trị.
items.explanationEn: equality /iˈkwɒləti/ (noun): a test that values are equal. An "equality condition" has the form column = value.

items.question: Trong câu "InnoDB is clustered: rows live in the primary-key tree, so random UUIDv4 keys cause page splits.", từ "cluster" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "InnoDB is clustered: rows live in the primary-key tree, so random UUIDv4 keys cause page splits.", what does "cluster" (verb) mean?
options: lưu gộp theo thứ tự khóa
optionsEn: to store rows in key order
items.explanation: cluster /ˈklʌstə(r)/ (động từ): lưu gộp theo thứ tự khóa. "Clustered index" = dữ liệu dòng nằm ngay trong cây khóa chính, theo thứ tự khóa.
items.explanationEn: cluster /ˈklʌstə(r)/ (verb): to store rows in key order. A "clustered index" stores row data inside the primary-key tree, in key order.

items.question: Trong câu "Indexes cost writes: every INSERT/UPDATE maintains every index.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Indexes cost writes: every INSERT/UPDATE maintains every index.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): cập nhật, duy trì. "Maintain an index" = giữ index luôn đúng mỗi khi dữ liệu thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep up to date. "Maintain an index" means keeping it correct whenever the data changes.

items.question: Trong câu "Index killers: a function on the column (lower(email) needs an expression index), LIKE '%x', type casts, low-selectivity columns.", từ "selectivity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Index killers: a function on the column (lower(email) needs an expression index), LIKE '%x', type casts, low-selectivity columns.", what does "selectivity" (noun) mean?
options: độ chọn lọc của giá trị
items.explanation: selectivity /səˌlekˈtɪvəti/ (danh từ): độ chọn lọc của giá trị. "Low selectivity" = cột ít giá trị khác nhau (vd. giới tính), index ít hữu ích.
items.explanationEn: selectivity /səˌlekˈtɪvəti/ (noun): how well values narrow rows. "Low selectivity" means a column has few distinct values, so an index helps little.

items.question: Trong câu "EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs the query and shows real timings (it really executes DML).", từ "execute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs the query and shows real timings (it really executes DML).", what does "execute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: execute /ˈeksɪkjuːt/ (động từ): thực thi, chạy. "Execute a query" = chạy truy vấn thật sự, không chỉ lập kế hoạch.
items.explanationEn: execute /ˈeksɪkjuːt/ (verb): to run a command. "Execute a query" means actually running it, not just planning it.

items.question: Trong câu "A seq scan is correct when a query returns a large share of the table.", từ "share" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A seq scan is correct when a query returns a large share of the table.", what does "share" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: share /ʃeə(r)/ (danh từ): phần, tỷ lệ. "A large share of" = một phần lớn của; ở đây là tỷ lệ dòng trả về.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeə(r)/ (noun): a portion of a whole. "A large share of" means a big portion of; here, of the table's rows.

items.question: Trong câu "find offenders with pg_stat_statements or MySQL's slow query log.", từ "offender" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "find offenders with pg_stat_statements or MySQL's slow query log.", what does "offender" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: offender /əˈfendə(r)/ (danh từ): thứ gây ra vấn đề. Nghĩa gốc là người phạm tội; trong kỹ thuật chỉ truy vấn "thủ phạm" gây chậm.
items.explanationEn: offender /əˈfendə(r)/ (noun): the thing causing trouble. Literally a lawbreaker; in tech it names the query that causes the slowdown.

items.question: Trong câu "The write-ahead log (WAL) is appended and flushed before data pages change; after a crash it is replayed, and the same stream feeds replication.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The write-ahead log (WAL) is appended and flushed before data pages change; after a crash it is replayed, and the same stream feeds replication.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append-only log" = nhật ký chỉ ghi nối thêm, không sửa dòng cũ.
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add to the end. An "append-only log" only adds new entries and never edits old ones.

items.question: Trong câu "The write-ahead log (WAL) is appended and flushed before data pages change; after a crash it is replayed, and the same stream feeds replication.", từ "flush" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The write-ahead log (WAL) is appended and flushed before data pages change; after a crash it is replayed, and the same stream feeds replication.", what does "flush" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go red in the face
items.explanation: flush /flʌʃ/ (động từ): ghi đẩy xuống đĩa. "Flush to disk" = đẩy dữ liệu từ bộ nhớ đệm xuống ổ đĩa để không mất khi sập.
items.explanationEn: flush /flʌʃ/ (verb): to write buffers to disk. "Flush to disk" means pushing buffered data to storage so a crash cannot lose it.

items.question: Trong câu "The write-ahead log (WAL) is appended and flushed before data pages change; after a crash it is replayed, and the same stream feeds replication.", từ "replay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The write-ahead log (WAL) is appended and flushed before data pages change; after a crash it is replayed, and the same stream feeds replication.", what does "replay" (verb) mean?
options: áp dụng lại theo thứ tự
items.explanation: replay /ˌriːˈpleɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng lại theo thứ tự. "Replay the log" = chạy lại các thay đổi đã ghi để khôi phục trạng thái.
items.explanationEn: replay /ˌriːˈpleɪ/ (verb): to reapply recorded steps. "Replay the log" means reapplying recorded changes to rebuild the state.

items.question: Trong câu "MVCC keeps row versions so readers and writers do not block each other; the cost is cleanup (VACUUM in PostgreSQL), which long-running transactions block.", từ "block" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MVCC keeps row versions so readers and writers do not block each other; the cost is cleanup (VACUUM in PostgreSQL), which long-running transactions block.", what does "block" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop a hit in sport
items.explanation: block /blɒk/ (động từ): chặn, bắt phải chờ. "Block each other" = chờ nhau; "blocking" là tình trạng phải đợi khóa.
items.explanationEn: block /blɒk/ (verb): to make something wait. "Block each other" means forcing each other to wait for locks.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic race is read-modify-write: two requests read balance 500 and both write 400.", từ "race" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic race is read-modify-write: two requests read balance 500 and both write 400.", what does "race" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: race /reɪs/ (danh từ): lỗi tranh chấp đồng thời. Viết tắt của "race condition": kết quả sai do các thao tác đồng thời chen nhau.
items.explanationEn: race /reɪs/ (noun): a timing-dependent bug. Short for "race condition": wrong results because concurrent steps interleave.

items.question: Trong câu "Anomalies: dirty read (see uncommitted data), non-repeatable read (a row changes between two reads), phantom (new rows appear in a range), write skew (two transactions read the same facts and update different rows, together breaking a rule).", từ "anomaly" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Anomalies: dirty read (see uncommitted data), non-repeatable read (a row changes between two reads), phantom (new rows appear in a range), write skew (two transactions read the same facts and update different rows, together breaking a rule).", what does "anomaly" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: anomaly /əˈnɒməli/ (danh từ): hiện tượng bất thường. "Anomaly detection" = phát hiện bất thường; ở đây là các lỗi đọc do đồng thời.
items.explanationEn: anomaly /əˈnɒməli/ (noun): an unexpected irregularity. "Anomaly detection" finds irregularities; here the term covers concurrency read errors.

items.question: Trong câu "Anomalies: dirty read (see uncommitted data), non-repeatable read (a row changes between two reads), phantom (new rows appear in a range), write skew (two transactions read the same facts and update different rows, together breaking a rule).", từ "skew" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Anomalies: dirty read (see uncommitted data), non-repeatable read (a row changes between two reads), phantom (new rows appear in a range), write skew (two transactions read the same facts and update different rows, together breaking a rule).", what does "skew" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: skew /skjuː/ (danh từ): sự sai lệch, lệch. "Data skew" = dữ liệu phân bố lệch; "write skew" = ghi lệch làm vỡ quy tắc.
items.explanationEn: skew /skjuː/ (noun): a distortion or imbalance. "Data skew" is uneven data; "write skew" is concurrent writes that break a rule.

items.question: Trong câu "Real engines differ — a favourite interview probe:", từ "probe" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real engines differ — a favourite interview probe:", what does "probe" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: probe /prəʊb/ (danh từ): câu hỏi thăm dò. "Interview probe" = câu hỏi để thử độ hiểu sâu của ứng viên.
items.explanationEn: probe /prəʊb/ (noun): a searching question. An "interview probe" is a question that tests how deep a candidate's knowledge goes.

items.question: Trong câu "PostgreSQL Repeatable Read is snapshot isolation: no phantoms, but write skew is possible.", từ "isolation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PostgreSQL Repeatable Read is snapshot isolation: no phantoms, but write skew is possible.", what does "isolation" (noun) mean?
options: sự cô lập giữa giao dịch
items.explanation: isolation /ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự cô lập giữa giao dịch. "Isolation level" = mức độ các giao dịch đồng thời bị tách khỏi nhau.
items.explanationEn: isolation /ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/ (noun): separation between transactions. An "isolation level" sets how much concurrent transactions are shielded from each other.

items.question: Trong câu "Its Serializable (SSI) aborts conflicts with a serialization failure, so the app must retry.", từ "abort" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its Serializable (SSI) aborts conflicts with a serialization failure, so the app must retry.", what does "abort" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: abort /əˈbɔːt/ (động từ): hủy bỏ giữa chừng. "Abort a transaction" = hủy giao dịch và hoàn tác mọi thay đổi của nó.
items.explanationEn: abort /əˈbɔːt/ (verb): to cancel midway. "Abort a transaction" means cancelling it and undoing its changes.

items.question: Trong câu "Write skew: two doctors are on call, the rule is "at least one".", từ "on call" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write skew: two doctors are on call, the rule is "at least one".", what does "on call" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on call /ɒn kɔːl/ (cụm từ): trực sẵn sàng khi cần. "Be on call" = trực, sẵn sàng xử lý sự cố; kỹ sư cũng có ca "on-call".
items.explanationEn: on call /ɒn kɔːl/ (phrase): available for duty if needed. "Be on call" means ready to respond; engineers also take on-call shifts.

items.question: Trong câu "Each checks "someone else is on call" and signs off; under snapshot isolation both commit.", từ "sign off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each checks "someone else is on call" and signs off; under snapshot isolation both commit.", what does "sign off" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to log out of an app
items.explanation: sign off /saɪn ɒf/ (cụm từ): rời ca, thôi trực. "Sign off" có hai nghĩa: kết thúc ca làm, hoặc "sign off on" = phê duyệt.
items.explanationEn: sign off /saɪn ɒf/ (phrase): to go off duty. "Sign off" can mean ending a shift; "sign off on" means approving something.

items.question: Trong câu "Each checks "someone else is on call" and signs off; under snapshot isolation both commit.", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each checks "someone else is on call" and signs off; under snapshot isolation both commit.", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): xác nhận ghi giao dịch. "Commit a transaction" = chốt thay đổi vĩnh viễn; trái nghĩa là "roll back".
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to make changes final. "Commit a transaction" makes its changes permanent; the opposite is "roll back".

items.question: Trong câu "is the default for PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB replica sets: one node accepts writes and streams its log.", từ "stream" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is the default for PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB replica sets: one node accepts writes and streams its log.", what does "stream" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stream /striːm/ (động từ): truyền liên tục. "Stream the log" = gửi nhật ký thay đổi liên tục sang các follower.
items.explanationEn: stream /striːm/ (verb): to send data continuously. "Stream the log" means sending change records continuously to followers.

items.question: Trong câu "Failover promotes a follower; guard against split brain (the old leader still accepting writes) with fencing.", từ "promote" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Failover promotes a follower; guard against split brain (the old leader still accepting writes) with fencing.", what does "promote" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to raise to the main role
items.explanation: promote /prəˈməʊt/ (động từ): nâng lên vai trò chính. "Promote a replica" = biến bản sao thành leader nhận ghi.
items.explanationEn: promote /prəˈməʊt/ (verb): to raise to the main role. "Promote a replica" means turning it into the leader that accepts writes.

items.question: Trong câu "Failover promotes a follower; guard against split brain (the old leader still accepting writes) with fencing.", từ "guard against" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Failover promotes a follower; guard against split brain (the old leader still accepting writes) with fencing.", what does "guard against" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: guard against /ɡɑːd əˈɡenst/ (cụm từ): phòng ngừa, đề phòng. "Guard against X" = áp dụng biện pháp để X không xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: guard against /ɡɑːd əˈɡenst/ (phrase): to take steps to prevent. "Guard against X" means taking measures so that X does not happen.

items.question: Trong câu "Failover promotes a follower; guard against split brain (the old leader still accepting writes) with fencing.", từ "fencing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Failover promotes a follower; guard against split brain (the old leader still accepting writes) with fencing.", what does "fencing" (noun) mean?
options: cơ chế cô lập nút cũ
items.explanation: fencing /ˈfensɪŋ/ (danh từ): cơ chế cô lập nút cũ. Trong hệ phân tán, "fencing" ngăn leader cũ tiếp tục ghi (vd. token, STONITH).
items.explanationEn: fencing /ˈfensɪŋ/ (noun): cutting off a stale node. In distributed systems, "fencing" stops an old leader from writing (tokens, STONITH).

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-leader: writes in several regions, conflicts must be resolved (last-write-wins, CRDTs).", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-leader: writes in several regions, conflicts must be resolved (last-write-wins, CRDTs).", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết, xử lý. "Resolve a conflict" = chọn giá trị cuối cùng khi hai bản ghi mâu thuẫn.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to settle a conflict. "Resolve a conflict" means choosing the final value when two writes disagree.

items.question: Trong câu "If W + R > N reads overlap the latest write (N=3, W=2, R=2).", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If W + R > N reads overlap the latest write (N=3, W=2, R=2).", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lấn, giao nhau. Khi tập đọc và tập ghi "overlap", ít nhất một nút đọc có bản ghi mới nhất.
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (verb): to partly cover the same. When read and write sets overlap, at least one node read holds the latest write.

items.question: Trong câu "Aurora keeps 6 copies across 3 AZs (write quorum 4/6, read 3/6) and supports up to 15 read replicas on shared storage.", từ "quorum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Aurora keeps 6 copies across 3 AZs (write quorum 4/6, read 3/6) and supports up to 15 read replicas on shared storage.", what does "quorum" (noun) mean?
options: số phiếu tối thiểu cần đủ
items.explanation: quorum /ˈkwɔːrəm/ (danh từ): số phiếu tối thiểu cần đủ. "Write quorum 4/6" = cần 4 trên 6 bản xác nhận thì ghi mới thành công.
items.explanationEn: quorum /ˈkwɔːrəm/ (noun): minimum number needed to agree. "Write quorum 4/6" means 4 of 6 copies must confirm before a write succeeds.

items.question: Trong câu "Route reads to followers, writes to the leader.", từ "route" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Route reads to followers, writes to the leader.", what does "route" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (động từ): định tuyến, điều hướng. "Route traffic to X" = chuyển lưu lượng tới X.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (verb): to send along a path. "Route traffic to X" means directing requests to X.

items.question: Trong câu "Async followers lag: usually milliseconds, but seconds or more under heavy writes or large migrations.", từ "lag" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Async followers lag: usually milliseconds, but seconds or more under heavy writes or large migrations.", what does "lag" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lag /læɡ/ (động từ): chậm, tụt lại phía sau. "Replication lag" = độ trễ giữa lúc leader ghi và lúc replica nhận.
items.explanationEn: lag /læɡ/ (verb): to fall behind. "Replication lag" is the delay between a leader write and the replica seeing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Pin a session to one replica", từ "pin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pin a session to one replica", what does "pin" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pin /pɪn/ (động từ): gắn cố định vào. "Pin a session to a replica" = mọi lần đọc của phiên đều đi tới cùng một replica.
items.explanationEn: pin /pɪn/ (verb): to fix to one target. "Pin a session to a replica" sends all its reads to that same replica.

items.question: Trong câu "Replicas do not scale writes, and a replica is not a backup — DROP TABLE replicates too.", từ "replicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replicas do not scale writes, and a replica is not a backup — DROP TABLE replicates too.", what does "replicate" (verb) mean?
options: được sao chép sang bản khác
optionsEn: to be copied to other nodes
items.explanation: replicate /ˈreplɪkeɪt/ (động từ): được sao chép sang bản khác. "Changes replicate" = thay đổi (kể cả lệnh xóa) được sao chép sang replica.
items.explanationEn: replicate /ˈreplɪkeɪt/ (verb): to be copied to other nodes. "Changes replicate" means every change, even a drop, is copied to replicas.

items.question: Trong câu "Replicas do not scale writes, and a replica is not a backup — DROP TABLE replicates too.", từ "backup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replicas do not scale writes, and a replica is not a backup — DROP TABLE replicates too.", what does "backup" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: backup /ˈbækʌp/ (danh từ): bản sao lưu. "Back up" (động từ) = sao lưu; "backup" (danh từ) = bản sao lưu để khôi phục.
items.explanationEn: backup /ˈbækʌp/ (noun): a saved copy for recovery. "Back up" is the verb; a "backup" is the saved copy used to restore data.

items.question: Trong câu "The planner skips irrelevant partitions (partition pruning), and dropping an old partition replaces a huge DELETE.", từ "irrelevant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The planner skips irrelevant partitions (partition pruning), and dropping an old partition replaces a huge DELETE.", what does "irrelevant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: irrelevant /ɪˈreləvənt/ (tính từ): không liên quan. "Irrelevant to the query" = không chứa dữ liệu truy vấn cần.
items.explanationEn: irrelevant /ɪˈreləvənt/ (adjective): not related. "Irrelevant to the query" means holding no data the query needs.

items.question: Trong câu "The planner skips irrelevant partitions (partition pruning), and dropping an old partition replaces a huge DELETE.", từ "pruning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The planner skips irrelevant partitions (partition pruning), and dropping an old partition replaces a huge DELETE.", what does "pruning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pruning /ˈpruːnɪŋ/ (danh từ): loại bỏ phần không cần. Nghĩa gốc là tỉa cành; "partition pruning" = bỏ qua các phân vùng không liên quan.
items.explanationEn: pruning /ˈpruːnɪŋ/ (noun): cutting away unneeded parts. Originally trimming plants; "partition pruning" skips partitions that cannot match.

items.question: Trong câu "Newest range is a hot spot", từ "hot spot" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Newest range is a hot spot", what does "hot spot" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: hot spot /ˈhɒt spɒt/ (cụm từ): điểm dồn tải quá mức. "Hot spot" = nơi dồn quá nhiều truy cập trong khi nơi khác nhàn rỗi.
items.explanationEn: hot spot /ˈhɒt spɒt/ (phrase): a point of heavy load. A "hot spot" gets far more traffic than the rest of the system.

items.question: Trong câu "Range queries fan out; changing N moves most keys", từ "fan out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Range queries fan out; changing N moves most keys", what does "fan out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fan out /fæn aʊt/ (cụm từ): tỏa ra nhiều nơi. "Fan out" = một yêu cầu phải gửi tới nhiều shard; ngược lại là "fan in".
items.explanationEn: fan out /fæn aʊt/ (phrase): to spread to many targets. "Fan out" means one request goes to many shards; the reverse is "fan in".

items.question: Trong câu "Lookup is a critical dependency", từ "critical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lookup is a critical dependency", what does "critical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/ (tính từ): then chốt, sống còn. "Critical dependency" = thành phần mà nếu hỏng thì cả hệ thống ngừng.
items.explanationEn: critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/ (adjective): essential, vital. A "critical dependency" is a part whose failure stops the whole system.

items.question: Trong câu "A good shard key has high cardinality, even load, appears in hot queries (one request, one shard), and rarely changes.", từ "cardinality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A good shard key has high cardinality, even load, appears in hot queries (one request, one shard), and rarely changes.", what does "cardinality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cardinality /ˌkɑːdɪˈnæləti/ (danh từ): số giá trị khác nhau. "High cardinality" = cột có rất nhiều giá trị riêng biệt (vd. user_id).
items.explanationEn: cardinality /ˌkɑːdɪˈnæləti/ (noun): count of distinct values. "High cardinality" means a column has many distinct values, like user IDs.

items.question: Trong câu "A good shard key has high cardinality, even load, appears in hot queries (one request, one shard), and rarely changes.", từ "even" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A good shard key has high cardinality, even load, appears in hot queries (one request, one shard), and rarely changes.", what does "even" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: even /ˈiːvn/ (tính từ): đồng đều, cân bằng. "Even distribution" = dữ liệu/tải chia đều cho các shard.
items.explanationEn: even /ˈiːvn/ (adjective): spread equally. "Even distribution" means data and load split equally across shards.

items.question: Trong câu "Usually excellent; move giant tenants to their own shard", từ "tenant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Usually excellent; move giant tenants to their own shard", what does "tenant" (noun) mean?
options: khách hàng dùng chung hệ thống
items.explanation: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (danh từ): khách hàng dùng chung hệ thống. "Multi-tenant" = nhiều khách hàng dùng chung một hệ thống, dữ liệu tách riêng.
items.explanationEn: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (noun): a customer sharing a platform. "Multi-tenant" means many customers share one system with separated data.

items.question: Trong câu "Permanent costs: scatter-gather queries, cross-shard transactions (two-phase commit or sagas — see the microservices topic), globally unique IDs (UUIDv7, Snowflake IDs), hot keys (a celebrity account), and resharding.", từ "celebrity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Permanent costs: scatter-gather queries, cross-shard transactions (two-phase commit or sagas — see the microservices topic), globally unique IDs (UUIDv7, Snowflake IDs), hot keys (a celebrity account), and resharding.", what does "celebrity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: celebrity /səˈlebrəti/ (danh từ): người nổi tiếng. Tài khoản người nổi tiếng có hàng triệu follower nên tạo "hot key".
items.explanationEn: celebrity /səˈlebrəti/ (noun): a famous person. A celebrity account has millions of followers, so its key becomes a hot key.

items.question: Trong câu "Pre-split into many logical shards mapped onto few physical nodes so growth moves whole logical shards.", từ "logical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pre-split into many logical shards mapped onto few physical nodes so growth moves whole logical shards.", what does "logical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: logical /ˈlɒdʒɪkl/ (tính từ): theo khái niệm, ảo. "Logical shard" = shard về mặt khái niệm, có thể dời sang máy khác.
items.explanationEn: logical /ˈlɒdʒɪkl/ (adjective): conceptual, not hardware. A "logical shard" is a conceptual unit that can be moved to other hardware.

items.question: Trong câu "Pre-split into many logical shards mapped onto few physical nodes so growth moves whole logical shards.", từ "physical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pre-split into many logical shards mapped onto few physical nodes so growth moves whole logical shards.", what does "physical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: physical /ˈfɪzɪkl/ (tính từ): thuộc phần cứng thật. "Physical node" = máy chủ thật; đối lập với "logical" (khái niệm).
items.explanationEn: physical /ˈfɪzɪkl/ (adjective): relating to real hardware. A "physical node" is a real server, in contrast to a logical one.

items.question: Trong câu "DynamoDB and Cassandra do this natively via the partition key.", từ "natively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DynamoDB and Cassandra do this natively via the partition key.", what does "natively" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: built in, out of the box
items.explanation: natively /ˈneɪtɪvli/ (trạng từ): sẵn có, tích hợp. "Supports X natively" = hỗ trợ sẵn, không cần công cụ ngoài.
items.explanationEn: natively /ˈneɪtɪvli/ (adverb): built in, out of the box. "Supports X natively" means it is built in, with no extra tool needed.

items.question: Trong câu "DynamoDB and Cassandra do this natively via the partition key.", từ "via" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DynamoDB and Cassandra do this natively via the partition key.", what does "via" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: via /ˈvaɪə/ (giới từ): thông qua, bằng. "Via X" = thông qua X; hay gặp trong "via API", "via email".
items.explanationEn: via /ˈvaɪə/ (preposition): by means of. "Via X" means by means of X, as in "via API" or "via email".

items.question: Trong câu "when a network partition happens, a distributed store must choose Consistency (linearizable reads) or Availability (every live node answers).", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when a network partition happens, a distributed store must choose Consistency (linearizable reads) or Availability (every live node answers).", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (tính từ): phân tán nhiều máy. "Distributed system" = hệ thống chạy trên nhiều máy phối hợp qua mạng.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (adjective): spread over many machines. A "distributed system" runs on many machines working together over a network.

items.question: Trong câu "when a network partition happens, a distributed store must choose Consistency (linearizable reads) or Availability (every live node answers).", từ "live" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when a network partition happens, a distributed store must choose Consistency (linearizable reads) or Availability (every live node answers).", what does "live" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: live /laɪv/ (tính từ): đang hoạt động. Đọc là /laɪv/ khi là tính từ; "live node" = nút còn chạy, chưa bị lỗi.
items.explanationEn: live /laɪv/ (adjective): up and running. Pronounced /laɪv/ as an adjective; a "live node" is one still running.

items.question: Trong câu "Partitions are unavoidable, so "CA" is not a real option.", từ "unavoidable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Partitions are unavoidable, so "CA" is not a real option.", what does "unavoidable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unavoidable /ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl/ (tính từ): không thể tránh khỏi. Lỗi mạng là "unavoidable", nên hệ phân tán luôn phải chọn C hoặc A khi có sự cố.
items.explanationEn: unavoidable /ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl/ (adjective): impossible to prevent. Network faults are unavoidable, so distributed stores must pick C or A when one occurs.

items.question: Trong câu "adds the normal-operation trade-off CAP ignores.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "adds the normal-operation trade-off CAP ignores.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance between gains and costs
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Trade-off between A and B" = được cái này thì mất cái kia.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance between gains and costs. A "trade-off between A and B" means gaining one costs you the other.

items.question: Trong câu "Eventually consistent reads by default; stronger reads opt-in", từ "eventually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Eventually consistent reads by default; stronger reads opt-in", what does "eventually" (adverb) mean?
options: sau một thời gian, rốt cuộc
optionsEn: in the end, after a delay
items.explanation: eventually /ɪˈventʃuəli/ (trạng từ): sau một thời gian, rốt cuộc. Dễ nhầm với "có thể"; "eventually consistent" = sẽ nhất quán sau một lúc.
items.explanationEn: eventually /ɪˈventʃuəli/ (adverb): in the end, after a delay. Not "possibly"; "eventually consistent" means data agrees after some delay.

items.question: Trong câu "Many systems make the choice per request (Cassandra consistency levels, DynamoDB ConsistentRead).", từ "per" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many systems make the choice per request (Cassandra consistency levels, DynamoDB ConsistentRead).", what does "per" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: per /pɜː(r)/ (giới từ): cho mỗi, theo từng. "Per request" = cho từng yêu cầu; tương tự "per second", "per user".
items.explanationEn: per /pɜː(r)/ (preposition): for each. "Per request" means for each request, like "per second" or "per user".

items.question: Trong câu "Transaction mode breaks session state: SET, session advisory locks, LISTEN, and prepared statements unless max_prepared_statements (1.21+) is set.", từ "break" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transaction mode breaks session state: SET, session advisory locks, LISTEN, and prepared statements unless max_prepared_statements (1.21+) is set.", what does "break" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: break /breɪk/ (động từ): làm hỏng, phá vỡ. "Break X" trong kỹ thuật = khiến X không còn chạy đúng.
items.explanationEn: break /breɪk/ (verb): to stop from working. In tech, "break X" means causing X to stop working correctly.

items.question: Trong câu "Transaction mode breaks session state: SET, session advisory locks, LISTEN, and prepared statements unless max_prepared_statements (1.21+) is set.", từ "advisory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transaction mode breaks session state: SET, session advisory locks, LISTEN, and prepared statements unless max_prepared_statements (1.21+) is set.", what does "advisory" (adjective) mean?
options: mang tính tự nguyện, khuyến nghị
items.explanation: advisory /ədˈvaɪzəri/ (tính từ): mang tính tự nguyện, khuyến nghị. "Advisory lock" = khóa do ứng dụng tự quy ước, database không tự áp dụng.
items.explanationEn: advisory /ədˈvaɪzəri/ (adjective): voluntary, only a recommendation. An "advisory lock" is one the app agrees to honour; the database does not enforce it.

items.question: Trong câu "Transaction mode breaks session state: SET, session advisory locks, LISTEN, and prepared statements unless max_prepared_statements (1.21+) is set.", từ "unless" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transaction mode breaks session state: SET, session advisory locks, LISTEN, and prepared statements unless max_prepared_statements (1.21+) is set.", what does "unless" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: unless /ənˈles/ (liên từ): trừ khi. "A unless B" = A xảy ra, trừ trường hợp có B.
items.explanationEn: unless /ənˈles/ (conjunction): except if. "A unless B" means A happens except when B is true.

items.question: Trong câu "a common start is (cores x 2) + spindles, and instances x pool size must stay under the server limit.", từ "spindle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a common start is (cores x 2) + spindles, and instances x pool size must stay under the server limit.", what does "spindle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spindle /ˈspɪndl/ (danh từ): trục quay ổ đĩa. Trong công thức pool, "spindles" = số ổ đĩa quay vật lý.
items.explanationEn: spindle /ˈspɪndl/ (noun): a disk drive axle. In the pool formula, "spindles" counts physical spinning disks.

items.question: Trong câu "Each extra store must be secured, backed up and kept in sync (CDC or events): default to one relational database until a measured need justifies more, and record the choice in an ADR.", từ "in sync" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each extra store must be secured, backed up and kept in sync (CDC or events): default to one relational database until a measured need justifies more, and record the choice in an ADR.", what does "in sync" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in sync /ɪn sɪŋk/ (cụm từ): được đồng bộ, khớp nhau. "Keep in sync" = giữ các bản dữ liệu luôn khớp; ngược lại là "out of sync".
items.explanationEn: in sync /ɪn sɪŋk/ (phrase): matching, kept aligned. "Keep in sync" means keeping copies matching; the opposite is "out of sync".

items.question: Trong câu "Each extra store must be secured, backed up and kept in sync (CDC or events): default to one relational database until a measured need justifies more, and record the choice in an ADR.", từ "measured" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each extra store must be secured, backed up and kept in sync (CDC or events): default to one relational database until a measured need justifies more, and record the choice in an ADR.", what does "measured" (adjective) mean?
options: đã đo đạc có số liệu
items.explanation: measured /ˈmeʒəd/ (tính từ): đã đo đạc có số liệu. "Measured need" = nhu cầu đã được đo bằng số liệu; "measured tone" = giọng chừng mực.
items.explanationEn: measured /ˈmeʒəd/ (adjective): backed by real numbers. A "measured need" is proven by data; a "measured tone" is calm and restrained.

items.question: Trong câu "Each extra store must be secured, backed up and kept in sync (CDC or events): default to one relational database until a measured need justifies more, and record the choice in an ADR.", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each extra store must be secured, backed up and kept in sync (CDC or events): default to one relational database until a measured need justifies more, and record the choice in an ADR.", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (động từ): biện minh cho, đáng để. "Justify the cost" = có lý do xứng đáng để bỏ ra chi phí đó.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (verb): to give good reason for. "Justify the cost" means having a good enough reason to pay it.

items.question: Trong câu "The database is hardest to scale because it holds state; diagnose the pressure before picking a fix.", từ "diagnose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The database is hardest to scale because it holds state; diagnose the pressure before picking a fix.", what does "diagnose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: diagnose /ˈdaɪəɡnəʊz/ (động từ): xác định nguyên nhân. "Diagnose a problem" = tìm ra nguyên nhân trước khi sửa.
items.explanationEn: diagnose /ˈdaɪəɡnəʊz/ (verb): to identify the cause. "Diagnose a problem" means finding its cause before fixing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Replication buys availability and read scale at the price of lag and failover complexity.", từ "at the price of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replication buys availability and read scale at the price of lag and failover complexity.", what does "at the price of" (phrase) mean?
options: với cái giá phải trả là
items.explanation: at the price of /æt ðə praɪs əv/ (cụm từ): với cái giá phải trả là. "Gain A at the price of B" = được A nhưng phải chịu mất B.
items.explanationEn: at the price of /æt ðə praɪs əv/ (phrase): at the cost of. "Gain A at the price of B" means getting A while giving up B.

items.question: Trong câu "ACID and the right isolation level keep concurrent work correct.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ACID and the right isolation level keep concurrent work correct.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌrənt/ (tính từ): diễn ra đồng thời. "Concurrent users" = người dùng truy cập cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌrənt/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Concurrent users" are users active at the same time.

items.question: Trong câu "Partitioning tames big tables; sharding buys write scale at a permanent complexity cost.", từ "tame" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Partitioning tames big tables; sharding buys write scale at a permanent complexity cost.", what does "tame" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: tame /teɪm/ (động từ): chế ngự, kiểm soát. "Tame complexity" = kiểm soát được sự phức tạp.
items.explanationEn: tame /teɪm/ (verb): to bring under control. "Tame complexity" means bringing complexity under control.

items.question: Trong câu "CAP/PACELC frame consistency vs availability and latency; pooling protects the database from connection storms.", từ "frame" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CAP/PACELC frame consistency vs availability and latency; pooling protects the database from connection storms.", what does "frame" (verb) mean?
options: đặt khung, diễn đạt vấn đề
optionsEn: to put a picture in a frame
items.explanation: frame /freɪm/ (động từ): đặt khung, diễn đạt vấn đề. "Frame the problem" = trình bày vấn đề theo một cách nhìn cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: frame /freɪm/ (verb): to set out a problem. "Frame the problem" means presenting it from a particular viewpoint.

items.question: Trong câu "CAP/PACELC frame consistency vs availability and latency; pooling protects the database from connection storms.", từ "storm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CAP/PACELC frame consistency vs availability and latency; pooling protects the database from connection storms.", what does "storm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: storm /stɔːm/ (danh từ): đợt dồn dập đột ngột. "Connection storm" = hàng loạt kết nối mở cùng lúc làm quá tải database.
items.explanationEn: storm /stɔːm/ (noun): a sudden flood of events. A "connection storm" is a sudden burst of connections that overloads the database.
